newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Inespal hit by one-day strike.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Inespal hit by one-day strike.

text.p: Spanish aluminum group Inespal's workers are staging a 24-hour strike in protest against the possible sale of the state-owned company, trade unions told Reuters on Thursday.

"Today the strike involves Inespal's 4,587 workers plus iron and steel sector workers. We have also called another strike on July 10, for all public steel firms' workers," a source at the General Workers' Union (UGT) said.
He added the protest today also involves some 12,000 workers of CSI-Corporacion siderurgica.
"In both firms protests are against sale plans," the source explained.

State holding group Sociedad Estatal de Participaciones Industriales (SEPI), which controls Inespal, said on Tuesday talks were continuing with Aluminum Company of America (Alcoa) on the sale of Inespal.
On July 10, the strike will involve 52,000 workers, and trade unions have called for a public protest in Madrid.
The impact of today's strike varied from a total stoppage at one Inespal plant in the Asturias region and at Valencia's CSI to a more than 50 percent rate at the other Inespal plant.
